title: Finch Circle Courtesy Reissue — Starting Days by the Lapsed Note's Original Validity
content:
**Rule.** For a courtesy reissue of a Finch Note in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the tier courtesy days are the standard courtesy note validity of the tier on the membership record. When the lapsed note had been issued with a validity of 120 days or more (its issue date to its expiry date, both counted) the tier courtesy days are 30, when that validity was 90 days or more but less than 120 they are 21, and otherwise they stay the standard courtesy note validity of the tier on the membership record.

The lapsed note is the member's most recently lapsed note, among notes that lapsed with their validity ended. Its issue date and expiry date are read from its issue entry in the membership's note history; the standard courtesy note validity of each tier is that of the reinstated and courtesy note terms.

| Validity the lapsed note was issued with (issue date to expiry date, both counted) | Tier courtesy days |
|---|---|
| 120 days or more | 30 |
| 90 days or more but less than 120 | 21 |
| less than 90 days | the standard courtesy note validity of the tier on the membership record |

## Counting the validity (hypothetical)

- Issued 1 June, expiry date 28 September: 120 days counted with both ends, so 30.
- Issued 1 June, expiry date 29 August: 90 days, so 21.
- Issued 1 June, expiry date 30 July: 60 days, so the standard figure of the tier on the membership record.
- Issued 1 June, expiry date 27 September: 119 days, so 21.
